method: direction = mean over group minimal-pairs of (stereotype_embedding - anti_stereotype_embedding), masked-mean per sentence, at a chosen layer (block index or 'emb').
layer_source: this repo's directional-steering regime (block L14 is where race directions were built/evaluated: see directional_steering/, race_steering/).
coeff_source: this repo's race_steering/directional sweep used alpha in {4,8,12,...}; 4 is the low end matched to CAA/ours for comparison.
